ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity black pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with 15% mid-to-high intensity grey and white linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black regions across both lobes; symmetrical light-grey linear streaks radiating from the peduncle insertion point towards the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; a distinct irregular indentation is visible on the inner margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges, tapering to acute, slightly upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of high-contrast white circular pixels at the distal extremity of the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical linear streaks (rake marks) observed in the medial regions of both the left and right lobes, disrupting the primary black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple vertical rake marks on both lobes; irregular white scarring/pigmentation loss on the distal tip of the right lobe.
